text.title: 新门上的告示
text.situation:
包裹服务柜台再过去两条街，米娜正打开一间窄窄的小店。这个经营场所原来属于一位修鞋师傅，墙上还留着一排钉孔。她此前在网上开了一个小生意，出售本地作坊制作的包。这家店是生意第一次扩展。米娜在市场上认识过其他创业者，但没人能说准她第一周会怎样。杰伊带着借来的水壶来了。他很有主意，建议修好空货架，不必买新的。十点时橱窗擦干净了，一辆商业送货车也找到了后门。米娜把告示转向街道，烧水还得等等。

街角小店——今日开业
零售：本地制作的包和首饰。
小件维修：请把物品带到柜台，询问预估价格。
营业时间：周二至周六，上午十点至下午六点。
送货：请走后门。

paragraphs.en: Two streets beyond the parcel counter, Mina was unlocking a narrow shop. These premises had once belonged to a shoe repairer; a row of nail holes still marked the wall. She had established a small business online, selling bags made by local workshops. This shop was its first expansion. Mina had met other entrepreneurs at the market, but none could tell her exactly how her first week would go. Jay arrived carrying a borrowed kettle. He was enterprising enough to suggest repairing the empty shelves instead of buying new ones. By ten, the window was clean and a commercial delivery van had found the rear door. Mina turned the sign towards the street. The kettle would have to wait.

paragraphs.en:
CORNER SHOP — OPEN TODAY
Retail sales: locally made bags and jewellery.
Small repairs: please bring the item to the counter for an estimate.
Opening hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.
Deliveries: use the rear door.

S08.Q01.P01.function: The sign on the new door
S08.Q01.P01.cue: 说说店址、生意怎样开始，以及米娜在市场上认识了谁。
acceptableAnswers: 米娜打开店门，走进店铺。 米娜在网上创办了一个小生意。 米娜在市场上认识过其他创业者。

S08.Q01.P02.function: The sign on the new door
S08.Q01.P02.cue: 说说杰伊的主意和后门的送货。
acceptableAnswers: 杰伊很有主意，提出修好货架。 一辆商业送货车停在后门。

S08.Q01.P03.function: The sign on the new door
S08.Q01.P03.cue: 说说店卖什么，以及生意怎样扩大。
acceptableAnswers: 告示介绍零售业务。 这家店是生意第一次扩展。

S08.Q01.T01.function: The sign on the new door
S08.Q01.T01.cue: 朋友创办了一家网上小店，怎么介绍？
